title: Andy Anderson, Frog and Percy Humphrey
summary: Allen asks whom he played with; he describes few jobs with Anderson, the Cincinnati trip with Frog, and Humphrey.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: This is Reel 3, Joe Watkins, January 20th, 1961. Right. Alright, Joe. See, I got my notebook here, but I thought of something before I got to the notebook. What about Andy Anderson? Did you ever play with him?

Well, no. I only played with Andrew twice before he went off with us this last time. Well, that was back in the 40s. We played a job with him down the 9th Ward, and somewhere else we played a job with him. I can't exactly think where it's at. Whose band was that? It was with George.
I thought he played Neomaraka with you.

No, no. He played a couple of times with us at Paddock to place Howard. What about Frog? Did you ever work with Frog or anything? No, that was the first time I would work with Frog. When? Was on his last trip to Cincinnati. Oh, cool. Yeah, the first time I would work with him.

Played with him once before that, but that was a carnival about two years ago. Mm-hmm. A carnival a year ago, out at the old Absinthe House. Well, you know you can't get much volume out in the street in cold weather. Mm-hmm. So I didn't know really how good he could play until we went off to Cincinnati and then I found out what a real good trombone man he was. Mm-hmm. And I really must say I loved his playing. Mm-hmm.
Well, I thought he was in the El Moraco when Jim was out a couple of times. No, not when I was there.
Yeah, several. I worked with him many times. Because he played with us back at Manners. He played with us on several other jobs. And that's a real good authentic trumpet man too. Mm-hmm.
Seems to me he came out about the time... I think it was Cuckoo, and then Moran at the El Moraco, and then Percy. No, long before that.

No, long before that huh? Because you remember when I was telling you about the... We played over in Biloxi. I think Butt Roussel had him on trumpet, I'm more than sure. Mm-hmm. He was on trumpet and his brother, Brother Earl, was on trombone. That was the first time I ever played with him. But he didn't play in the El Moraco, Percy? He might have played a couple of times in Cuckoo's place, I don't know. Mm-hmm. It's hard for me to memorize it right now. Was Moran in the El Moraco? I think he played with us one night. Mm-hmm. Yeah, I think he played with us about one night.
